independent_review:
# Independent source review

A separate read-only reviewer found no blocking production or test-source findings.
Production review verified the pinned legacy signature, exact normalization,
float rounding, active OptionsSlot validation, independent array ownership and
RAII cleanup. The getter creates no draft or binding store and leaves the modern
full-precision API unchanged.

Final test changes are additive. Existing assertions and registrations remain.
The previously noticed C++ initializer-list issue was fixed before compilation.
Coverage includes all generated setting/input combinations, normalization and
case sensitivity, rounding versus modern precision, independent returned arrays
and vectors, owner destruction, active unselected drafts, invalid arguments,
constructing/closed/wrong-thread reads, and active-stroke pixel/Undo neutrality.
Nonfinite and out-of-range coordinates are rejected by supported writers; tests
verify the previous draft remains intact. Forced allocation failure and corrupt
live-curve getter rejection remain source-reviewed, not runtime-injected.

limits: Seven selected suites, not full GIMP acceptance. LSan disabled; ASan+UBSan halt and abort on errors.
Only the owned query operation is restored. No original object/class layout, runtime GType or binary ABI compatibility claim.
The active modern model owns a draft even without a selected source. Queries read that existing draft. Constructing, unavailable and closed models return empty outputs; no getter-side draft creation.
Every supplied output is reset before validation; both outputs are required. Invalid owners, names, input indices and wrong-thread queries return no array.

Nonfinite/unrepresentable live coordinates and allocation failure are guarded in source. Supported writers already reject invalid coordinates; no forced allocation failure or corrupt live-curve runtime injection was performed.
The getter has no UI change. No screenshot acceptance claim is needed.

Other 75 entries, including row 36 and partial row 58, separate 31 hooks, type/handle catalog, 141/661 and 08.018 remain unchanged/open. Row 50 and row 57 remain open. ImageGenerator retirement and blocked perspective are excluded.
